IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Health & Long-Term Care.

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning fees for dental services that are not covered by insurance or contract.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fees for dental services that are not coveredservices under dental insurance or dental health care servicecontracts; adding a new section to chapter 48.20 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 48.21 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 48.44RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any other provisions of law, no disabilityinsurance policy of any disability insurer as provided in this chaptersubject to the jurisdiction of the state of Washington that covers anydental services, and no contract or participating provider agreementwith a dentist may: (a) Require, directly or indirectly, that a dentist who is aparticipating provider provide services to a subscriber at a fee setby, or at a fee subject to the approval of, the disability insurerunless the dental services are covered services under the applicabledisability insurance policy; nor p. 1 SB 6427 (b) Prohibit, directly or indirectly, a dentist who is aparticipating provider from offering or providing to a subscriberdental services that are not covered services on any terms orconditions acceptable to the dentist and the subscriber. (2) For the purposes of this section, "covered services" meansdental services that are reimbursable under the applicable insurancepolicy or subscriber agreement or would be reimbursable but for theapplication of contractual limitations such as benefit maximums,deductibles, coinsurance, waiting periods or frequency limitations.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any other provisions of law, no groupdisability insurance contract or blanket disability insurance contractof any disability insurer as provided for in this chapter subject tothe jurisdiction of the state of Washington that covers any dentalservices, and no contract or participating provider agreement with adentist may: (a) Require, directly or indirectly, that a dentist who is aparticipating provider provide services to a subscriber at a fee setby, or at a fee subject to the approval of, the disability insurerunless the dental services are covered services under the applicablegroup plan or disability insurance policy; nor (b) Prohibit, directly or indirectly, a dentist who is aparticipating provider from offering or providing to a subscriberdental services that are not covered services on any terms orconditions acceptable to the dentist and the subscriber. (2) For the purposes of this section, "covered services" meansdental services that are reimbursable under the applicable insurancepolicy, group plan, or subscriber agreement or would be reimbursablebut for the application of contractual limitations such as benefitmaximums, deductibles, coinsurance, waiting periods or frequencylimitations.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any other provisions of law, no contract of any SB 6427 p. 2 health care service contractor subject to the jurisdiction of the stateof Washington that covers any dental services, and no contract orparticipating provider agreement with a dentist may: (a) Require, directly or indirectly, that a dentist who is aparticipating provider provide services to an enrolled participant ata fee set by, or at a fee subject to the approval of, the health careservice contractor unless the dental services are covered servicesunder the applicable group contract or individual contract; nor (b) Prohibit, directly or indirectly, a dentist who is aparticipating provider from offering or providing to an enrolledparticipant dental services that are not covered services on any termsor conditions acceptable to the dentist and the enrolled participant. (2) For the purposes of this section, "covered services" meansdental services that are reimbursable under the applicable subscriberagreement or would be reimbursable but for the application ofcontractual limitations such as benefit maximums, deductibles,coinsurance, waiting periods or frequency limitations.
